plain_english: No helper is wanted at all, no hinderer is seen in Your vision — yet all is flooded by You alone: how is it even so that You do not see?
sanskrit_cite: sahakāri na kiñcid iṣyate bhavato na pratibandhakaṃ dṛṣi bhavataiva hi sarvam āplutaṃ katham adyāpi tathāpi nekṣase

plain_english: From things, senses, awareness-middle, ever self-born — may I see Him, world-veiled.
sanskrit_cite: api bhāvagaṇād apīndriyapracayād apy avabodhamadhyataḥ prabhavantam api svataḥ sadā paripaśyeyam apoḍhaviśvakam

plain_english: How could things come to be, and how reach Your path of vision, inlaid by what great nature-limb? Rising and rising, from land-water-grass on, You scatter nectar-floods of creation over all things.
sanskrit_cite: kathaṃ te jāyeran katham api ca te darśanapathaṃ vrajeyuḥ kenāpi prakṛtimahatāṅkena khacitaḥ tathotthāyotthāya sthalajalatṛṇāder akhilataḥ padārthadyānsṛṣṭisravadamṛtapūrair(?) vikirasi

plain_english: Sated with Your form-nectar, thirst uprooted, drunk — they wander at will.
sanskrit_cite: sākṣatkṛta bhavadrūpaprasṛtāmṛtatarpitāḥ unmūlitatṛṣo mattā vicaranti yathāruci

plain_english: Not then, not always, not once — where no time-thought is: such is Your vision, neither eternal nor otherwise.
sanskrit_cite: na tadā na sadā na caikadety api sā yatra na kāladhīr bhavet tad idaṃ bhavadīyadarśanaṃ na ca nityaṃ na ca kathyate 'nyathā

plain_english: May my mind, risen to see You, gain this yoga-fruit always: to enter Your nectar-house by mere resolve, for Your worship.
sanskrit_cite: tvadvilokanasamutkacetaso yogasiddhir iyatī sadāstu me yad viśeyam abhisandhimātratas tvatsudhāsadanam arcanāya te

plain_english: The clear-minded great ones' pure play and words shine plainly, playfully.
sanskrit_cite: nirvikalpabhavadīyadarśanapraptiphullamanasāṃ mahātmanām ullasanti vimalāni helayā ceṣṭitāni ca vacāṃsi ca sphuṭam

plain_english: Dwelling between Your feet, fearless — in those and those world-grounds may I worship the Lord, unbarred in act.
sanskrit_cite: bhavanbhavadīyapādayor nivasann antara eva nirbhayaḥ bhavabhūmiṣu tāsu tāsv ahaṃ prabhum arceyam anargalakriyaḥ

plain_english: Dissolved in Your foot-lake, melted seeking, honey-drunk to excess — may I roam satisfied, at will.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadaṅghrisaroruhodare parilīno galitaparaiṣaṇaḥ atimātramadhūpayogataḥ paritṛpto vicareyam icchayā

plain_english: Whose resolve to worship You arose even from pretense — to him too, assuredly, has arisen Thy fitting presence.
sanskrit_cite: yasya dambhād iva bhavatpūjāsaṅkalpa utthitaḥ tasyāpy avaśyam uditaṃ sannidhānaṃ tavocitam

plain_english: Lord, with one-taste mind seeking nothing else — the all-laying Lord, easy — may I drink my fill: what am I?
sanskrit_cite: bhagavann itarān apekṣiṇā nitarām ekarasena cetasā sulabhaṃ sakalopaśāyinaṃ prabhum ātṛpti pibeyam asmi kim

plain_english: By You denied: all where You're absent is to be left; where it's You, to be taken — this is the essence-extract.
sanskrit_cite: tvayā nirākṛtam sarvaṃ heyam etat tad eva tu tvanmayaṃ samupādeyam ity ayaṃ sārasaṃgrahaḥ

plain_english: The world-born, moving inside Thee, is worshipped as chief through its coming-forth — how, Lord, could mere non-being outside Thee be worshipped, and by whom?
sanskrit_cite: bhavato 'ntaracāri bhāvajātaṃ prabhuvanmukhyatayaiva pūjitaṃ tat bhavato bahir apy abhāvamātrā katham īśān bhavet samarcyate vā

plain_english: Noiseless, thought-free, undistracted, always — in agitation too, face to face: I see You alone everywhere, Three-eyed.
sanskrit_cite: niḥśabdaṃ nirvikalpaṃ ca nirvyākṣepam athānisam kṣobhe 'py adhyakṣamī kṣeyaṃ tryakṣa tvām eva sarvataḥ

plain_english: Reveal Your abode where You ever are with the Goddess; foot-dust-ranked servants — why do they look faithless?
sanskrit_cite: prakaṭaya nijadhāma deva yasmiṃs tvam asi sadā parameśvarīsametaḥ prabhucaraṇarajaḥsamānakakṣyāḥ kim aviśvāsapadaṃ bhānti bhṛtyāḥ

plain_english: Come to path's seeing yet fled — whence, Lord, to me Your servant? Never for a moment here are You not every being's sight-object.
sanskrit_cite: darśanapatham upayāto 'py apasarasi kuto mameśa bhṛtyasya kṣaṇamātrakam iha na bhavasi kasya na jantor dṛśor viṣayaḥ

plain_english: When, Lord, with oneness-nectar's pure unbroken stream wilt Thou flood me — that beyond the flood, bringing non-difference, I may gain Thee and my own body, joyfully?
sanskrit_cite: aikyasaṃvidamṛtācchadhārayā santataprasṛtayā kadā vibho plāvanāt paramabhedamānayaṃs tvāṃ nijaṃ ca vapur āpnuyāṃ mudam

plain_english: From my understanding fenced off from yonder world, a grain of world-establishment — that I be worshipped by You.
sanskrit_cite: aham ity amuto 'varuddhalokād bhavadīyāt pratipattisārato me aṇumātrakam eva viśvaniṣṭhaṃ ghaṭatāṃ yena bhaveyam arcitā te

plain_english: Seeing every thing each moment, O form beyond measure — may I see You well, my own Lord.
sanskrit_cite: aparimitarūpam ahaṃ taṃ taṃ bhāvaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ paśyan tvām eva viśvarūpaṃ nijanāthaṃ sādhu paśyeyam

plain_english: Why doesn't mind haunt what limbs love, the desired thing for desire? If no nature is harmed and my supreme wish is filled...
sanskrit_cite: bhavadaṅgagataṃ tam eva kasmān na manaḥ paryaṭatīṣṭam artham artham prakṛtikṣatir asti no tathāsya mama cecchā paripūryate paraiva

plain_english: Hundreds, they say, by Your power, with this very eye — even plough-walking — always see Your body ahead.
sanskrit_cite: śataśaḥ kila te tavānubhāvād bhagavan ke 'py amunaiva cakṣuṣā ye api hālikaceṣṭayā carantaḥ paripaśyanti bhavadvapuḥ sadāgre

plain_english: No thought rises unstained by Your will; always good or else — thus I roam as Yours on earth, feast of Your foot unstopped.
sanskrit_cite: na sā matir udeti yā na bhavati tvadicchāmayī sadā śubham athetarad bhagavataivam ācaryate ato 'smi bhavadātmako bhuvi yathā tathā sañcaran sthi to 'niśam abādhitatvadamalaṅghripūjotsavaḥ

plain_english: May insight rise well in Your deep sayings; then practiced power too, and unpausing worship-addiction.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadīyagabhīrabhāṣiteṣu pratibhā samyag udetu me puro 'taḥ tadanuṣṭhitaśaktir apy atas tadbhavadarcāvyasanaṃ ca nirvirāmam

plain_english: In dealings too, always, may this sense-heap appear to me as Your limb — not self-warranted.
sanskrit_cite: vyavahārapade 'pi sarvadā pratibhātv arthakalāpa eṣa mām bhavato 'vayavo yathā na tu svata evādaraṇīyatāṃ gataḥ

plain_english: Mind roaming freely in its fields, unswerving — may I ever be worship-skilled toward You.
sanskrit_cite: manasi svarasena yatra tatra pracaraty apy aham asya gocareṣu prasṛto 'py avilola eva yuṣmatparicaryācaturaḥ sadā bhaveyam

plain_english: Lord, by Your will alone Your slave I was made — another's no power here — yet why never see Your face-moon?
sanskrit_cite: bhagavan bhavadicchayaiva dāsas tava jāto 'smi parasya nātra śaktiḥ katham eṣa tathāpi vaktrabimbaṃ tava paśyāmi na jātu citram etat

plain_english: The eager toward You who face You as counter-form — ah, what would befall them, what practice would fruit for them?
sanskrit_cite: samutsukās tvāṃ prati ye bhavantaṃ pratyartharūpād avalokayanti teṣām aho kiṃ tadupasthitaṃ syāt kiṃ sādhanaṃ vā phalitaṃ bhavet tat

plain_english: May things be as things by Your being for me; thus may nothing be otherwise, nothing but You.
sanskrit_cite: bhāvā bhāvatayā santu bhavadbhāvena me bhava tathā na kiñcid apy astu na kiñcid bhavato 'nyathā

plain_english: May nothing-at-all be nothing, something-at-all be something to me; in all ways may You be worship-received.
sanskrit_cite: yan na kiñcid api tanna kiñcid apy astu kiñcid api kiñcid eva me sarvathā bhavatu tāvatā bhavān sarvato bhavati labdhapūjitaḥ
